lemmas.statement: The declared zero relation of the fiber residual of a report p coincides with equality of p-values, so fibers are carried independently of any quotient presentation.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem L {X M : Type} (p : X → M) (x y : X) : zeroRel (fiberResidual p) x y ↔ p x = p y := fiber_zeroRel_iff p x y

lemmas.statement: For the constant report constFalse, the residual quotient of its fiber setoid is a subsingleton.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem L (q1 q2 : ResidualQuotient (fiberSetoid constFalse)) : q1 = q2 := sorry
